text: APPROVE: `AppendStar` reproduces the original three branches exactly (single `*` gives `[^/]*` with no index change, `**/` gives `(?:[^/]*/)*` with `i + 2`, and a trailing `**` gives `.*` with `i + 1`). The nested ifs leave `ToRegex`, so its cognitive complexity drops below 15. The new private static helper uses the same fully qualified `StringBuilder` and has no unused parameters or other warning triggers, so the build should be unaffected. I did not run the build or tests; this is from reading the diff.
